text:
Provisional complexity assessment

Entities: One primary business entity. Its identity, fields, relationships, attachments, and history requirements remain unspecified.
Roles: Two unspecified roles, provisionally interpreted as a standard user who manages permitted records and an administrator who manages all records and access.
Workflow states: No states are confirmed. A simple lifecycle might be draft, active or submitted, completed, and archived, with only basic transitions.
Integrations: None are currently identified. Authentication, email notifications, file storage, payments, reporting, or third-party APIs would add complexity if required.
Security needs: Authentication, role-based authorization, record-level access rules, input validation, secure data storage and transport, audit logging where needed, and protection of administrative actions.
Overall rating: Simple, provisionally. It becomes medium if it needs sensitive data controls, approvals, complex state transitions, record ownership rules, auditability, or external integrations.

Assessment limitation: The entity definition, exact permissions, workflow, integrations, and data sensitivity are not supplied, so this is a conditional assessment rather than a confirmed design classification.
limitations: The application’s substantive requirements are unspecified beyond one entity and two roles.
